purpose: Independently verify the completed Stage86 result bundle, quantify physical constraint fidelity, and decide whether any further Dirac-3 global-penalty jobs are justified.

decision.primary_endpoint: At least one raw physical sample must be fully feasible and recover the certified exact optimum.
decision.failure_action: Stop the QCI Dirac-3 global unconstrained-penalty route. Do not spend the remaining free allocation on repetitions or post-hoc schedule tuning.
decision.future_hardware_boundary: A future hardware experiment requires a separately preregistered interface with native constraints or a genuine warm-start/local-move mechanism.
